episodes.title: You'd Know What to Do
episodes.summary: After the battle of Acre, we join the Knights Templar in Paris where Landry, a veteran of the Holy Wars, fears that the Order has lost its way. When the blood of a brother is shed, Landry and the Templars are forced to take up their swords again.

episodes.title: Find Us the Grail
episodes.summary: Landry and Parsifal search for a killer. The unexpected arrival of Pope Boniface in Paris threatens De Nogaret's carefully laid plans.

episodes.title: The Black Wolf and the White Wolf
episodes.summary: On the Pope's orders, Landry and Tancrede travel to investigate the Holy Grail's whereabouts. Meanwhile, the plotting behind the royal wedding becomes deadly.

episodes.title: He Who Discovers His Own Self, Discovers God
episodes.summary: A pagan helps Landry search his past. Gawain conducts a murder investigation. Princess Isabella is betrayed.

episodes.title: Hard Blows Will Banish the Sin
episodes.summary: Tensions are high during Isabella's wedding preparations. Fearing an attack, King Philip asks Landry and the Knights Templar for their help in protecting the palace.

episodes.title: The Pilgrimage of Chains
episodes.summary: Landry is kidnapped and tortured by a mysterious group. A Knight is expelled from the Templars. De Nogaret builds an army. Princess Isabella discovers who betrayed her.

episodes.title: And Certainly Not the Cripple
episodes.summary: Landry and Gawain meet a mysterious woman who claims she can lead them to the Grail; Joan hears of an attack on Navarre; De Nogaret devises a way to improve his standing with King Philip.

episodes.title: IV
episodes.summary: The Paris Temple of the Knights Templar is under siege; De Nogaret plants doubt in King Philip's mind; Queen Joan must decide what is best for Navarre.

episodes.title: Fiat!
episodes.summary: Landry seeks the help of Jacques de Molay, the Temple Grand Master; Queen Joan plots her escape.

episodes.title: Do You See the Blue?
episodes.summary: Vastly outnumbered, the Templar Knights must fight for their lives in a battle with the Red Knights.

episodes.title: God's Executioners
episodes.summary: Banished from the Knights Templar after the discovery of his affair with Queen Joan, Landry must work to redeem himself under the watchful eye of a mysterious veteran of the Crusades. King Philip formulates a plan to take action against the Templars, while dealing with the return of his erratic, eldest son, Prince Louis.

episodes.title: The Devil Inside
episodes.summary: Now back in the Knights Templar Order as an Initiate, Landry continues his training under the harsh guidance of Talus, the battle-hardened Initiate master. DeNogaret implores King Philip to build a legal case against the Knights, seeking the aid of a former Templar to help carry out his plan. Prince Louis is tasked with a shocking secret mission.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.summary: After suffering a casualty, the Knights Templar prepare to exact revenge.

episodes.title: Equal Before God
episodes.summary: A mysterious knight arrives at Chartres Temple and brings the Knights Templar devastating news. Louis struggles to produce an heir, creating a rift between he and his wife. King Philip sends Gawain on a mission where he comes face to face with his former Templar brothers.

episodes.title: Road to Chartres
episodes.summary: Landry reunites with his daughter, only to be separated once again. Growing impatient with DeNogaret's legal strategy, King Philip prepares his army for war. Margaret discovers one of Prince Louis' dark secrets.

episodes.title: Blood Drenched Stone
episodes.summary: King Philip launches a massive attack on the Chartres Temple, igniting a battle that will determine the fate of the Knights Templar.

episodes.title: Death Awaits
episodes.summary: The Knights Templar are captured and thrown into prison by King Philip. The king tortures Tancrede attempting to find where the Templar gold is hidden. Meanwhile Gawain searches for the gold and finds the two women and Landry's daughter while also revealing the corruption of the king. Isabella sets up Margaret as an adulterer and the king chains her in the tower to Prince Louis' anger. A mock trial is held with the king and pope and the Templars are tied to pires to be burned.

episodes.title: As I Breathe, I Trust the Cross
episodes.summary: The death of the Knights Templar Order is imminent as Landry and his Templar brothers are sentenced to burn at the stake.
